heroHeadline: Day 648: Sinaloa Legislature Appoints Interim Governor Bonilla Valverde — Political Collapse Deepens After Historic Rocha Moya US Indictment
heroSubtitle: 648 days of cartel civil war — Political crisis: Governor Rubén Rocha Moya took leave May 2 after the April 30 SDNY indictment (first sitting Mexican governor charged in US history); Culiacán Mayor Gámez Mendívil resigned same day, losing immunity; Sinaloa legislature appointed Yeraldine Bonilla Valverde as interim governor May 3. President Sheinbaum invoked sovereignty May 1, refusing extradition without 'irrefutable evidence' and ordering an independent probe. El Mayo EDNY sentencing: May 18. El Guano still at large. CJNG-Chapitos alliance structurally broken (El Jardinero captured Apr 29, El Mencho dead Feb 2026). Running conflict toll: ~2,425+ since Sep 9, 2024.
